correctness.rationale: The de la Vallée Poussin kernel identity V_n(t)=sin(nt/2)sin(3nt/2)/(n sin²(t/2)) follows by averaging D_n,…,D_{2n−1}. Partition N=nm samples into m cosets each with n values t_s+2πq/n. Both numerator sin factors change by (-1)^q and (-1)^{3q}, leaving their product fixed, so absolute summation invokes Σ csc²(x+πq/n)=n² csc²(nx). Each s≠0 coset contributes n|sin(3πs/m)/sin(πs/m)|=n|1+2 cos(2πs/m)|; s=0 contributes 3n with all other terms zero, by limits. The normalized absolute row/column sums prove both endpoint norms. The negative-index set m/3<s<2m/3 and elementary finite cosine-progressions give the three mod-3 formulas. Independent float recomputation examined 4680 n,m pairs with max decimation error <4.2e−14 and closed-form error <4.5e−16; these checks corroborate, not prove, all n,m.
residual_risks: Only N=nm, m≥4 and endpoint ℓ¹/ℓ∞; m<4 aliases frequencies.
Cosecant poles require continuity; s=0 was explicitly handled.
